claim_being_audited: The current release can be certified now based on aggregate launch readiness, with the municipal permitting assistant regression handled by documentation and informal monitoring context.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Certification is compliant only if material segment weaknesses for named launch use cases are disclosed or covered by approved mitigation before launch.
Aggregate readiness and lack of severity-one rehearsal incidents are supportive but do not override missing disclosure or risk-acceptance requirements.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes are contextual only and cannot substitute for current admissible support.
evidence_requests: Current model-card or release documentation showing the municipal permitting assistant weakness is explicitly disclosed for this release.
Approved risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation artifact covering the municipal permitting assistant regression before launch.
Current-release documentation demonstrating that evaluation results have been updated to reflect the present retrieval configuration and eval batch.
specific_concerns: Current admissible evidence shows a named launch use-case subgroup regression: the municipal permitting assistant slice is 1.3 percentage points below the warning threshold.
Policy requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
The packet does not include current-release disclosure language reflecting the subgroup weakness.
The packet does not include reviewed mitigation or approved risk acceptance for the subgroup weakness.
Prior approval predates the current retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it cannot substitute for current-release evidence.
The release-thread monitoring note is informal context only and is not an approved mitigation artifact.
unsupported_claims: That certification may proceed now without attached current-release disclosure or approved mitigation for the current subgroup weakness.
That prior approval and informal post-launch monitoring are sufficient to satisfy the release policy predicate for certification.
